subject: Shift intro demo into hands-on scoping — need to reschedule
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@edgestack.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Shift intro demo into hands-on scoping — need to reschedule

Hi Tom —

Thanks for the time yesterday. Based on your note about the exec visit and the team wanting a deeper, hands-on session rather than a high-level walkthrough, we'd like to propose converting the planned intro demo into a 90–120 minute technical scoping workshop (POC planning) so your engineers can validate end-to-end flow and we can draft a mutual action plan.

Because this is a change in format, it will need a different facilitator lineup (Vivek should lead the technical sections). I know you mentioned the week of Mar 15 for the original demo, but you also noted the VP will be onsite that week — can you confirm which days are blocked for travel? If that week is mostly blocked, we can propose alternate windows the following week.

Proposed next steps:
- Confirm whether we should convert the intro to a hands-on scoping workshop
- Share a short prework checklist for your team (I attached a draft agenda)
- Pick 2-3 alternate slots for reschedule (we'll suggest options below)

Suggested windows (all Pacific time):
- Tue Mar 23, 10:00–12:00
- Wed Mar 24, 13:00–15:00
- Thu Mar 25, 09:00–11:00 (shorter session)

Attachment: edgestack-poc-agenda-v1.pdf (pdf stub)

If you prefer to keep the original intro-level demo, say so and we'll keep it shorter — but I want to make sure we don't waste your team's time given the exec availability and the ask for depth.

Best,
David Kim
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@edgestack.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@edgestack.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Shift intro demo into hands-on scoping — need to reschedule

Thanks David — appreciate the flexibility.

Quick context: our VP will be onsite Mon–Thu of the week you suggested (Mar 15–18) and we have a couple of planned customer meetings that block most of the engineering team. We definitely want the deeper scoping workshop — our engineering lead (Samantha) will want to run through the API and data handling portion.

Of the proposed windows, Wed Mar 24 looks best for us but Samantha is out the morning of the 24th until 1pm for an external meeting — the 13:00–15:00 slot should be OK once she confirms. If not, Tue Mar 23 morning also works for a majority.

Can you share a short prework checklist? Also confirm who from your side will run the technical deep-dive and whether you need any sample data or network access details in advance.

Tom
VP Product
Edgestack
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Shift intro demo into hands-on scoping — need to reschedule

Thanks Tom — perfect, appreciate the quick reply.

Vivek will lead the technical scoping and pair with Marissa for the integration and success criteria section. I've attached a short prework doc (redwood-prework.md) and the updated agenda (edgestack-poc-agenda-v1.pdf) — prework items are light (sample payload, schema, and a short network whitelist if you want us to test against a staging endpoint).

Concrete proposal (please pick one):
- Option A: Wed Mar 24, 13:00–15:00 PT — full scoping workshop (recommended)
- Option B: Tue Mar 23, 10:00–12:00 PT — alternate (a bit earlier for PST teams)
- Option C: Thu Mar 25, 09:00–10:30 PT — compressed agenda if timeline is tight

Notes:
- We won't need any VPN; a staging endpoint + minimal whitelist is enough for the hands-on demos.
- We'll come prepared with a draft mutual action plan and initial latency/cost expectations so your team can validate feasibility during the session.

Attachments: redwood-prework.md (markdown stub), edgestack-poc-agenda-v1.pdf (pdf stub)

If you confirm Option A, I'll send a calendar invite and a shared Drive folder with the prework checklist and a short sample payload.

Thanks —
David
